content: Standard 3-tier AI difficulty for tic-tac-toe: Easy = fully random legal move; Medium = heuristic or partial-minimax (win-if-possible, block-if-threatened, else random, or minimax with shallow depth / probability blend of random+minimax moves); Hard = full minimax (optionally with alpha-beta pruning) evaluating the complete game tree, guaranteeing the AI never loses (win or draw only) since tic-tac-toe's state space is small (~765 unique positions with symmetry, ~5478 total). Depth-limiting or randomized move selection among equally-optimal moves are common ways to keep Hard from feeling robotic without breaking unbeatability.
